program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            if len(cells) < 4:
                continue
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            area = (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            if len(cells) / area >= 0.4:
                for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
